verdict.rationale: Mastra explicitly documents free self-hosting ('Self host your Mastra projects... Apache 2.0 licensed $0/month... Build and host agents anywhere') and states it can run on any Node.js-compatible environment or other runtimes (Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare). Community reports confirm active self-directed use of the framework outside any hosted SaaS. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of the exact license (a commenter disputes the 'Apache 2.0/open-source' framing, citing Elastic v2 restrictions on hosted-service resale, which slightly undercuts the openness claim though not the core self-host capability), and no first-party self-hosting deployment guide/tutorial specifics.
